test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Given below are four sentences in jumbled order. Pick the option that gives their correct order.**

A. We have flower arrangements to suit everybody at all prices.

B. We also make paying easy, and we accept all major credit cards at our shops or you can pay online.

C. Whether it is birthdays, weddings, or even the sad times like funerals, Fancy Flowers is there to make it easy.

D. Established in 2002, Fancy Flowers has branches all over the country.
solution:
The correct answer is **DACB**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The first sentence should be **sentence D** as it contains the introduction of Fancy Flowers which is a noun. 
 
• The second sentence should be **sentence A** which contains information about the business.
 
• **Sentence C** comes next in order which specifies the occasions for which Fancy Flowers provides its services.
 
• The last sentence should be **sentence B** which mentions the accepted payment methods at Fancy Flowers.
 
• Thus, the correct order of jumbled sentences is expressed in **option 4**.

**Correct Sequence:**__ *Established in 2002, Fancy Flowers has branches all over the country. We have flower arrangements to suit everybody at all prices. Whether it is birthdays, weddings, or even the sad times like funerals, Fancy Flowers is there to make it easy. We also make paying easy, and we accept all major credit cards at our shops or you can pay online.*
